SELECT ds.schedule_id, ds.doctor_id, d.doctor_name, ds.dept_id, dept.dept_name, ds.schedule_date, ds.time_slot, ds.used_quota, ds.status, ds.max_quota, ds.room_number FROM doctor_schedule ds LEFT JOIN doctor d ON d.doctor_id = ds.doctor_id LEFT JOIN department dept ON dept.dept_id = ds.dept_id
ds.schedule_date = #{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND ds.dept_id = #{deptId} AND ds.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND ds.time_slot = #{timeSlot} AND (d.doctor_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR dept.dept_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) AND ds.status = 1
ORDER BY ds.schedule_id ASC
